en: Hello! You have reached {org} customer support. Send us your message and our team will reply to you here.
am: ሰላም! የ{org} የደንበኞች አገልግሎት ነው። መልዕክትዎን ይላኩልን — ቡድናችን እዚሁ ይመልስልዎታል።
om: Akkam! Kun tajaajila maamiltootaa {org} ti. Ergaa keessan nuuf ergaa — gareen keenya asuma deebii isiniif kenna.
ti: ሰላም! እዚ ኣገልግሎት ዓማዊል {org} እዩ። መልእኽትኹም ስደዱልና — ጋንታና ኣብዚ ክምልሰልኩም እዩ።
so: Salaan! Kani waa adeegga macaamiisha ee {org}. Fariintaada noo soo dir — kooxdayadu halkan ayay kaaga jawaabi doontaa.
sw: Habari! Hii ni huduma kwa wateja ya {org}. Tutumie ujumbe wako — timu yetu itakujibu hapa.
note: First message when a customer opens a chat (Telegram /start, widget open). {org} is the organization's name. This is a human support desk, not a bot persona — it must not claim to be an assistant that answers by itself.

en: Thank you — your message has reached {org}. Your ticket number is {number}. Our team will reply to you here.
am: አመሰግናለሁ — መልዕክትዎ ለ{org} ደርሷል። የቲኬት ቁጥርዎ {number} ነው። ቡድናችን እዚሁ ይመልስልዎታል።
om: Galatoomaa — ergaan keessan {org} qaqqabeera. Lakkoofsi tiikeetii keessanii {number} dha. Gareen keenya asuma deebii isiniif kenna.
ti: የቐንየለይ — መልእኽትኹም ናብ {org} በጺሑ እዩ። ቁጽሪ ቲኬትኩም {number} እዩ። ጋንታና ኣብዚ ክምልሰልኩም እዩ።
so: Mahadsanid — fariintaadu waxay gaartay {org}. Lambarka tikidhkaagu waa {number}. Kooxdayadu halkan ayay kaaga jawaabi doontaa.
sw: Asante — ujumbe wako umefika {org}. Namba ya tiketi yako ni {number}. Timu yetu itakujibu hapa.
note: Auto-acknowledgement sent once when a new ticket is opened from an inbound message. {org} is the organization's name, {number} the human-facing ticket number. It promises a reply in this same chat — keep that promise explicit.

en: Thank you — your message was added to ticket {number}. Our team will get back to you.
am: አመሰግናለሁ — መልዕክትዎ ወደ ቲኬት {number} ታክሏል። ቡድናችን ያገኙዎታል።
om: Galatoomaa — ergaan keessan tiikeetii {number} irratti dabalameera. Gareen keenya isin qunnama.
ti: የቐንየለይ — መልእኽትኹም ናብ ቲኬት {number} ተወሲኹ እዩ። ጋንታና ክረኽበኩም እዩ።
so: Mahadsanid — fariintaada waxaa lagu daray tikidhka {number}. Kooxdayadu way kula soo xiriiri doontaa.
sw: Asante — ujumbe wako umeongezwa kwenye tiketi {number}. Timu yetu itawasiliana nawe.
note: Closing screen when a message joins an EXISTING ticket on a channel that must answer something (USSD ends every session with a screen). {number} is the ticket number. Unlike ticket_opened it must NOT promise a reply 'here' — a USSD session cannot be re-entered; the follow-up comes by phone or SMS.

en: Your request #{number} is resolved. How did we do? Reply with a number from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent).
am: ጥያቄዎ #{number} ተፈትቷል። እንዴት ሰራን? ከ1 (ደካማ) እስከ 5 (በጣም ጥሩ) ባለ ቁጥር ይመልሱ።
om: Gaaffiin keessan #{number} furameera. Akkamitti hojjenne? Lakkoofsa 1 (gadhee) hanga 5 (baayyee gaarii) ta'een deebisaa.
ti: ሕቶኹም #{number} ተፈቲሑ። ከመይ ሰሪሕና? ካብ 1 (ድኹም) ክሳብ 5 (ኣዝዩ ጽቡቕ) ብዘሎ ቍጽሪ መልሱ።
so: Codsigaaga #{number} waa la xalliyay. Sidee ayaan u shaqeynay? Ku jawaab lambar 1 (liita) ilaa 5 (aad u fiican).
sw: Ombi lako #{number} limetatuliwa. Tulifanyaje? Jibu kwa nambari kutoka 1 (duni) hadi 5 (bora sana).
note: CUSTOMER-FACING: sent once when a ticket is resolved, asking for a satisfaction score. {number} is the ticket number. The reply format must stay a plain 1-5 — it is typed on a phone keypad, sometimes over SMS, and the parser accepts a bare number only. Keep the two anchors (worst and best) so the scale is unambiguous without a legend.

en: Thank you — your feedback has been recorded.
note: CUSTOMER-FACING: the acknowledgement after a score is received. It must NOT promise any further action — the ticket is closed and nobody is coming back to them about it.
